key_reasoning.reason: New About view module and About controller, a new open_external Tauri command in the logger module, a force flag on the app-updater check, plus sidebar/renderer/runner-bridge wiring. That is 4 components across the UI and Rust command layers, with shared renderer state.

The diffstat reports 13 files (710 insertions). About 8 are modified (app_updater.rs, logger.rs, lib.rs, index.html, renderer.js, runner-bridge.js, styles.css, plus existing tests) and about 4 are new (about-controller.js, about-view.js and their tests), spread across src-tauri/ and ui/. This maps to XL on the actual-mode file scale.

The closest pattern is spawn_open for log files, which never handled untrusted input. open_external passes a URL to the OS opener, so an exact-match allowlist and rejection tests had to be added. That security gap bumped the score from S to M. The CLI version probe racing a CLI self-update is handled with a generation counter and by waiting on the probe.
